intentComment: Story 054 — migration set 1/2: initiate 24h withdrawal window on the 3 live yield strategies (DOLA/USDC/USDe), client=phUSD minter. PHASE-1 'initiate' only; no funds move. Calls totalWithdrawal(token, client) once per strategy, which from WithdrawalStatus.None routes into _initiateWithdrawal (snapshot principal, set Initiated, emit WithdrawalInitiated with executableAt = now + 24h). Story 055 (set 2) re-calls the same function in the [executableAt, executableAt+48h] window to execute (drain).
